apps.localizedDescription:
Quake3e for iPhone & Apple Vision Pro:

Play Quake III Arena on your iPhone and Apple Vision Pro — full single-player bot ladder, real internet multiplayer, mods, and on Vision Pro both a stereoscopic 3D mode (the game on a floating screen with real depth) and a full immersive VR mode: you stand inside the arena, world-locked and head-tracked, aiming with your gaze, a gamepad, or PlayStation VR2 Sense controllers. 100% vibe coded with lots of passion and attention to detail.

Built on Quake3e, the maintained, performance-focused ioquake3 engine, running its native Vulkan renderer on Metal. Locked 120 fps on ProMotion at native resolution.

versions.localizedDescription:
Installs over 1.1.1; you keep your settings and game data.

What's new in 1.1.2:

• The import screen now checks for all of pak0–pak8 and names exactly which files are missing or from the wrong version.

• Fixed: the Files recycle bin (.Trash) no longer shows up as a mod.

Thanks to everyone who reported the launch problem and sent logs.

Via SideStore source (recommended — auto-updates):

On Apple Vision Pro, first install SideStore onto the headset with.

then add the source in SideStore.

Or download and sideload manually:

• Quake3e-1.1.2-iOS.ipa — iPhone / iPad (iOS 16+).
• Quake3e-1.1.2-visionOS.ipa — Apple Vision Pro (visionOS 2+).

You bring the game: copy your own baseq3 folder (retail pak0.pk3 from Steam, GOG, or CD) into the app at first launch or via the Files app. Nothing copyrighted ships in these IPAs. See the README for setup, controls, and FAQ.

Built on Quake3e (Vulkan renderer on Metal via MoltenVK). GPL v2.
